description.en: Leafless forked shoots ending in expanded spore capsules.
description.zh: 无叶分叉枝轴末端带膨大的孢子囊。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Cooksonia pertoni; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Cooksonia pertoni 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Terminal capsules on a simple Y-axis network differ from leafy ground ferns and jointed horsetails.
distinctness.zh: 简单的Y形枝轴与顶生孢子囊区别于有叶蕨丛和具节木贼。

modeling_brief.en: Use slender faceted forks and flattened terminal caps; choose a readable sparse arrangement as an art decision.
modeling_brief.zh: 以细棱柱分叉和扁平顶囊建形；稀疏布局仅为美术选择。

uncertainty: Species boundaries and early vascular characters are debated; no flowers or leaves.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
